t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two baskets: red and yellow. The red basket links to the red, purple, brown and pink gnomes, and the yellow basket links to the yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes. The supply will alternate throughout the game, but will reduce incrementally once chosen. Therefore, it is advisable to keep choosing the same basket until the supply runs out and then switching.

vb_textbox.text: There are two baskets: red and yellow. If you select the red, purple, brown or pink gnome, the red basket will be chosen. In the alternative, if the yellow, orange, blue and green gnome is selected, the yellow basket will be chosen. One of the baskets (i.e. red or yellow) will provide more mushrooms for a period of time. Therefore, it is important to work out which basket is giving more mushrooms, and to keep selecting the relevant gnome for the correct basket to be chosen until the supply of mushrooms runs very low. It is then advisable to then switch to the other basket. The supply will keep switching throughout the game.
